list.label: A.
list.item: Allocated $2.5 million to refugee relief. These funds used to feed 300,000 refugees and contribute $500,000 to UNHCR.
list.label: B.
list.item: Encouraged and supported UNSYG and UNHCR in organizing international refugee relief program.
list.label: C.
list.item: Recommended approval of proposal to provide four C–130s for airlift of refugees from Tripura to Assam and of relief supplies from Assam to Tripura.
list.label: D.
list.item: Briefed the Indians on what we are doing to get relief operations started in East Pakistan and to encourage political accommodation.
list.label: E.
list.item: Urged Indians to use restraint in relations with Pakistan; warned them against direct action.

list.label: A.
list.item: Pressed GOP to request the UNSYG to coordinate large program of international relief assistance for people of East Pakistan; GOP has just sent such request to UNSYG.
list.label: B.
list.item: Initiated contingency planning under Interdepartmental Working Group for US contribution to relief program; we contemplate PL–480 food aid, financing of inland water transport charters and support for US voluntary agencies.
list.label: C.
list.item: Urged Yahya to restore peaceful conditions in East Pakistan, to stop repressive action against the Hindu minority and to encourage return of refugees.
list.label: D.
list.item: Urged Yahya to seek political accommodation with Bengalis, and to make comprehensive public statement of his plans for this and for restoration of economic normalcy.
list.label: E.
list.item: Arranged to send USDA port specialist to East Pakistan to help assess and recommend regarding alleviation of crucial port congestion, storage and internal distribution problems.
list.label: F.
list.item: Urged Yahya to improve port and inland distribution facilities to permit distribution of relief and other commodities to the populace.
list.label: G.
list.item: Emphasized to GOP need for maintaining restraint toward India in these tense circumstances.
